comparisons.question: Do the shipped bundled internal packages carry their dependency declarations?

comparisons.question: Does the shipped dist import packages the published manifest does not declare?
comparisons.label: VERIFIED
comparisons.method: Distinguished real module specifiers from string-literal catalog data. Raw substring scan of dist finds 37 distinct '@claude-flow/*' strings, but only 9 appear as actual module specifiers, and every one of those 9 is a DYNAMIC `await import(...)` — there are zero static `from '@claude-flow/*'` imports in dist. prepublish_transformations.observed_behavior: Its entire body is one statement: it overwrites ruflo/README.md with the monorepo root README.md. VERIFIED by checksum — the published ruflo README.md is sha256 fd3a16d0bbd889924a389764ea404e01117d5ead97f27b5511a15fde90520935, identical to the root README.md, while the ruflo/README.md that exists in the repository is a different 30004-byte file, sha256 24c10b72c52949fa6b0f384e3fd2b49e4158747dcfa5875eb1470b610b962915. The package-specific README in the repo is therefore never published; registry users of `ruflo` read the monorepo README instead.

Five distinct mutations. (1) Compiles ../swarm and then the CLI with the local tsc, because dist is git-ignored and 'publishing without a build can create a tarball whose declared entry point does not exist' (its own comment). (2) Stages the three internal runtime bundles. (3) Overwrites the package README.md with the monorepo root README.md — the CLI's own 30487-byte README.md at v3/@claude-flow/cli/README.md is never published. (4) DELETES the entire plugins/ directory and recreates it containing only ruflo-metaharness. (5) Runs generate-catalog-manifest.mjs, sign-helpers.mjs and verify-helpers.mjs.

`await rm(pluginsDir, { recursive: true, force: true })` followed by mkdir and a single `cp` of repoRoot/plugins/ruflo-metaharness. Source has 38 plugin directories and 599 files; the tarball has 1 directory and 50 files. 37 plugin directories are removed from the artifact by this code path.

Builds @claude-flow/{security,codex,plugin-agent-federation} and copies only their dist (plus .agents/skills for codex, README/LICENSE where present) into the target package's node_modules/@claude-flow/. Before writing each bundled manifest it calls createBundledRuntimeManifest, which DELETES dependencies, optionalDependencies, peerDependencies and peerDependenciesMeta and moves them under a non-standard rufloBundledRuntime.sourceDependencies key. The stated intent (its own doc comment at :139-143) is that 'installation never depends on an unpublished internal package coordinate'. The consequence is that npm has no record of these three packages' runtime dependencies.

Pins corepack pnpm@8.15.0 and builds @claude-flow/{hooks,shared,guidance}, then builds @claude-flow/swarm and @claude-flow/cli with npm, then stages internal runtime bundles into the repo root with build:false. Affects the `claude-flow` package, not the two audited tarballs.

Writes catalog-manifest.json at publish time. Counts agents from REPO_ROOT git-tracked files but skills from the CLI package root, so the shipped manifest mixes a repo-scoped number with a package-scoped number. Sets benchmark to null unless a signed submission exists for the same generation — the shipped manifest has benchmark: null, which is an honest disclosure.

Ed25519-signs the critical helper set with a private key sourced from a GCP secret (RUFLO_HELPERS_SIGNING_SECRET), an explicit key path, or ~/.ruflo/helpers-signing.key, and writes the signed manifest. The public half is stated to be baked into src/init/helper-signing.ts. This re-signing at publish time is why the shipped helpers.manifest.json does not match the one in the tagged source.

dist_source_parity: For @claude-flow/cli the shipped dist is a complete and non-redundant emission of the shipped-package's own TypeScript source AT THE FILE-SET LEVEL: 365 src .ts files produce exactly 365 dist .js and 365 dist .d.ts, with per-directory counts matching across all 24 subdirectories and the 12 root modules; the only src directory with no dist counterpart is src/types, which holds a single ambient optional-modules.d.ts that emits nothing. Byte-level or semantic equivalence is NOT established and cannot be in this lane, because zero dist files are git-tracked (.gitignore:104 ignores dist/, and `git ls-files | grep '/dist/'` returns 0) and this lane does not compile. A registry user therefore cannot audit what they run: src/ is absent from the tarball, so the only readable artifact is compiled output with no in-package source to diff it against. Separately, one genuine checked-in-versus-shipped divergence WAS detected: .claude/helpers/helpers.manifest.json in the v3.37.0 source tree declares version 3.34.0 and carries signature GyTvYvhL7vIta/4yyz1rIyl+DWJ+x4dJVfmcrKZJXlh4E/TcQK2bszRznlaG1o7LWSZTudaYj50w+/7dlv6lDg==, while the published tarball's copy declares 3.37.0 and carries a different signature wjNllO+6A/iFejatdXHUflp2Bx831zKmAHCsJANV8L93X/s/8unB79SJCG9MpiiFFnoCAx+ESPken/NV3oG2BQ==; and .claude/helpers/.helpers-version reads 3.32.29 in source but 3.33.0 in the tarball. Three mutually inconsistent version strings (3.37.0, 3.34.0, 3.33.0) are therefore in play across the tag and the artifact, and the shipped Ed25519 signature is not reproducible from, or checkable against, anything in the tagged repository.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: Source presence does not imply shipped availability here, and the gap is large and deliberate. Of 23 named @claude-flow workspace packages in the v3.37.0 source tree, 9 reach a `ruflo` consumer (the CLI itself, three bundled into the tarball, four declared as dependencies, one optional) and 14 do not. Of 38 plugin directories in source, 1 is published and 37 are deleted by an explicit rm+recreate at v3/@claude-flow/cli/scripts/prepare-publish.mjs:34-40.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: Three packages that the shipped compiled code imports are declared in no dependency field of the published @claude-flow/cli manifest and are not bundled in the tarball: @claude-flow/guidance (7 dynamic import sites), @claude-flow/embeddings (6) and @claude-flow/aidefence (5). npm is never instructed to install them. Because @claude-flow/aidefence backs the security-tools and security-command paths, this is the highest-consequence instance of the gap.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: The shipped catalog-manifest.json advertises 164 agents, but 90 agent markdown files are present in the published tarball. The two numbers are computed over different, only partially overlapping file sets, because the generator counts agents from the repository root while counting skills from the CLI package root (generate-catalog-manifest.mjs:33 versus :52). Both counts were reproduced independently. The advertised skills count of 34 is package-accurate; the advertised tools count of 397 was reproduced from source but cannot be checked against the package at all, because src/ is not shipped.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: A registry user cannot audit what they run. @claude-flow/cli ships compiled dist only, with no src/ and no LICENSE; dist is git-ignored and produced at publish time by prepublishOnly, so there is no in-repo build output to compare against. The one checked-in artifact that could be compared, .claude/helpers/helpers.manifest.json, does NOT match: source says version 3.34.0 with one Ed25519 signature, the tarball says 3.37.0 with another.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: The prepublish pipeline rewrites the three bundled internal packages' manifests to remove all four dependency fields (stage-internal-runtime-bundles.mjs:132-135), relocating them to a non-standard rufloBundledRuntime key that no package manager reads. Their runtime dependencies are consequently invisible to npm, to audit tooling, and to SBOM generation.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: Both published packages ship the monorepo root README instead of their own. ruflo/scripts/prepare-publish.mjs:8 and v3/@claude-flow/cli/scripts/prepare-publish.mjs:33 each overwrite the package README with the root one; the package-specific READMEs that exist in the repository (ruflo/README.md, 30004 bytes; v3/@claude-flow/cli/README.md, 30487 bytes) are never published. Registry documentation for both packages therefore describes the monorepo, and the README is the same file the audit charter notes still identifies the project as claude-flow.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: The `ruflo` package is 526 files of which the entry point uses 3. bin/ruflo.js imports only @claude-flow/cli and contains no reference to src/; the 523 src/ files, 499 of them a vendored SvelteKit sub-project complete with its own CI workflows, git hooks, Helm chart, a 543 KB WASM binary, two package-lock.json files and 1.3 MB of media, are packaged without being reachable from the binary.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: @ruvector/router-linux-x64-gnu is declared only at root package.json:95, in the separately published `claude-flow` package, and appears nowhere in either audited tarball. On the audited install path (`npm i ruflo`) it is not a factor. Platform divergence on that path is instead carried by @metaharness/darwin and the native optional dependencies better-sqlite3 and @napi-rs/keyring.

conclusions.label: VERIFIED
conclusions.text: Nothing credential-bearing was found. No .env, key, certificate, database or test-fixture file is present in either tarball, and agentdb.rvf is correctly excluded. The unexpected published content is bulk and opacity — a vendored sub-project, binaries, lockfiles, an agent-hook configuration tree and unverifiable benchmark receipts — not secrets.

conclusions.label: INFERRED
conclusions.text: The pattern across all of the above is a monorepo publish pipeline that emits a much smaller artifact than the repository advertises, while the artifact's own catalog metadata continues to describe the repository. Nothing observed is evidence of malice; the deletions are explicit, commented and intentional. The audit consequence is that repository-level capability inventories cannot be used to reason about what an installed copy contains.

conclusions.label: UNKNOWN
conclusions.text: Whether the three undeclared imports resolve at runtime, whether the bundled packages' stripped dependencies are satisfied by hoisting, whether the shipped .claude hook configuration activates on install, and what an arm64 macOS tree differs by from a linux x64 tree all require installation and execution. This lane performed neither and assigns no level above PACKAGED to any finding.
